options.B: The Governor is the real executive head of the state
options.C: The Governor is the chief administrative officer of a district
options.D: The Governor heads the High Court of Karnataka

questions.explanation: The Governor is the constitutional head of the state and exercises functions assigned by the Constitution, generally acting on the aid and advice of the Council of Ministers except where discretion is constitutionally permitted.

questions.subject: Karnataka Post-Independence
questions.question: Which of the following statements about the Chief Minister of Karnataka is correct?

options.A: The Chief Minister is the head of the Council of Ministers and the principal executive leader of the elected state government
options.B: The Chief Minister is the constitutional head of the state
options.C: The Chief Minister is the chief administrative officer of a district
options.D: The Chief Minister heads the High Court of Karnataka

questions.explanation: The Chief Minister is the head of the Council of Ministers and the principal executive leader of the elected state government.

questions.subject: Karnataka Post-Independence
questions.question: Which of the following statements about the difference between a district and a taluk in Karnataka is correct?

options.A: A district is a larger administrative unit; a taluk is a subdivision within a district used for revenue and local administration
options.B: A taluk is larger than a district
options.C: A district is only for urban areas; a taluk is only for rural areas

questions.explanation: A district is a larger administrative unit; a taluk is a subdivision within a district used for revenue and local administration.

questions.subject: Karnataka Post-Independence
questions.question: Which of the following statements about the Karnataka state public service system is correct?

options.A: It recruits and administers public servants for state departments and supports implementation of laws, policies and public services
options.B: It only conducts elections
options.C: It manages only the police force
options.D: It is a private recruitment agency

questions.explanation: It recruits and administers public servants for state departments and supports implementation of laws, policies and public services.

questions.subject: Karnataka Post-Independence
questions.question: Which of the following statements about the Gokak Committee is correct?

options.A: It was chaired by V. K. Gokak and examined the language policy for schools in Karnataka
options.B: It was chaired by L. G. Havanur and examined backwardness
options.C: It was chaired by Fazl Ali and examined state reorganisation
options.D: It was chaired by Aluru Venkata Rao and examined Kannada literature

questions.explanation: The Gokak Committee, chaired by writer V. K. Gokak, examined the language policy for schools in Karnataka.

questions.subject: Karnataka Post-Independence
questions.question: Which of the following statements about Bandaya Sahitya is correct?

options.A: It was a progressive and protest-oriented literary movement that emerged in Karnataka in the 1970s, expressing the experiences and demands of oppressed and marginalised groups
options.B: It was a royal literary tradition of the Wodeyar court
options.C: It was a movement to translate English literature into Kannada
options.D: It was a movement to promote classical Kannada poetry

questions.explanation: Bandaya Sahitya was a progressive and protest-oriented literary movement that emerged in Karnataka in the 1970s, expressing the experiences and demands of oppressed and marginalised groups.
